body:
you knew this one was coming, and honestly i'm still not ready 🧣

next stop on the Blank Spaces timeline: Taylor and Jake Gyllenhaal. spotted backstage at SNL in October 2010, split by that January. three months on the calendar!

and somehow it's the chapter fans file All Too Well under, with The Moment I Knew and We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together right beside it.

when the 10 minute version finally arrived on Red (Taylor's Version) in November 2021, it debuted at #1 and became the longest song ever to top the Hot 100. TEN MINUTES.
